Name: Revenue YoY Change
Expression:
VAR PreviousYearRevenue = [Revenue PY]

RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(PreviousYearRevenue),
        BLANK(),
        [Revenue] - PreviousYearRevenue
    )

Name: Revenue PYTD
Expression:
VAR LastDateWithSales =
    MAX(FactSales[InvoiceDate])

VAR PreviousYearStart =
    DATE(
        YEAR(LastDateWithSales) - 1,
        1,
        1
    )

VAR PreviousYearEnd =
    DATE(
        YEAR(LastDateWithSales) - 1,
        MONTH(LastDateWithSales),
        DAY(LastDateWithSales)
    )

RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Revenue],
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DATESBETWEEN(
            DimDate[Date],
            PreviousYearStart,
            PreviousYearEnd
        )
    )

Name: Rolling 12M Revenue
Expression:
VAR LastVisibleDate =
    MAX(DimDate[Date])

VAR LastDateWithSales =
    [Latest Sales Date]

RETURN
    IF(
        LastVisibleDate > LastDateWithSales,
        BLANK(),
        CALCULATE(
            [Revenue],
            DATESINPERIOD(
                DimDate[Date],
                LastVisibleDate,
                -12,
                MONTH
            )
        )
    )

Expression:

    ISINSCOPE(DimProduct[ProductName]),
    RANKX(
        ALLSELECTED(DimProduct[ProductName]),
        [Revenue],
        ,
        DESC,
        DENSE
    )
)

Name: Customer Profitability Status
Expression:
VAR Margin = [Gross Margin %]

RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK([Revenue]), BLANK(),
        [Gross Profit] < 0, "Loss-Making",
        Margin < 0.30, "Low Margin",
        Margin < 0.50, "Medium Margin",
        "High Margin"
    )

Name: Top N Product Filter
Expression:
VAR SelectedTopN =
    SELECTEDVALUE(
        'Top N Products'[Top N Products],
        10
    )

VAR ProductRank =
    [Product Revenue Rank]

RETURN
    IF(
        NOT ISBLANK(ProductRank)
            && ProductRank <= SelectedTopN,
        1,
        0
    )

Name: Top N Products Title
Expression:
VAR SelectedTopN =
    SELECTEDVALUE(
        'Top N Products'[Top N Products],
        10
    )

RETURN
    "Top "
        & SelectedTopN
        & " Products by Revenue"

Name: Top N Salesperson Filter
Expression:
VAR SelectedTopN =
    SELECTEDVALUE(
        'Top N Salespeople'[Top N Salespeople],
        5
    )

VAR SalespersonRank =
    [Salesperson Revenue Rank]

RETURN
    IF(
        NOT ISBLANK(SalespersonRank)
            && SalespersonRank <= SelectedTopN,
        1,
        0
    )

Name: Selected Metric Name
Expression:
VAR SelectedMetrics =
    SUMMARIZE(
        'Metric Selector',
        'Metric Selector'[Metric Selector],
        'Metric Selector'[Metric Selector Fields]
    )

RETURN
    IF(
        COUNTROWS(SelectedMetrics) = 1,
        MAXX(
            SelectedMetrics,
            'Metric Selector'[Metric Selector]
        ),
        "Revenue"
    )

Name: Current Year Budget to Cutoff
Expression:
VAR LastSalesDate =
    [Latest Sales Date]

VAR StartOfCurrentYear =
    DATE(
        YEAR(LastSalesDate),
        1,
        1
    )

RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Budget],
        DATESBETWEEN(
            DimDate[Date],
            StartOfCurrentYear,
            LastSalesDate
        )
    )

Name: Current Year Budget Variance %
Expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Current Year Budget Variance],
    [Current Year Budget to Cutoff]
)

Name: Target Performance Status
Expression:
VAR Achievement =
    [Target Achievement %]

RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK(Achievement), BLANK(),
        Achievement >= 1.05, "Above Target",
        Achievement >= 1.00, "On Target",
        Achievement >= 0.90, "Slightly Below Target",
        "Below Target"
    )

Name: Salespeople Below Target
Expression:
COUNTROWS(
    FILTER(
        VALUES(DimSalesperson[SalespersonID]),
        [Target Achievement %] < 1
            && NOT ISBLANK([Target Achievement %])
    )
)

Name: Comparable Revenue
Expression:
VAR FirstBudgetDate =
    CALCULATE(
        MIN(FactBudget[BudgetMonth]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate)
    )
VAR LastSalesDate =
    [Latest Sales Date]
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Revenue],
        KEEPFILTERS(
            DATESBETWEEN(
                DimDate[Date],
                FirstBudgetDate,
                LastSalesDate
            )
        )
    )

Name: Comparable Budget
Expression:
VAR LastSalesDate =
    [Latest Sales Date]
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Budget],
        KEEPFILTERS(
            DimDate[Date] <= LastSalesDate
        )
    )

Name: Comparable Salesperson Target
Expression:
VAR SelectedYear =
    SELECTEDVALUE(DimDate[Year])

VAR LastSalesDate =
    [Latest Sales Date]

VAR MonthsToCompare =
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK(SelectedYear), BLANK(),
        SelectedYear < YEAR(LastSalesDate), 12,
        SelectedYear = YEAR(LastSalesDate), MONTH(LastSalesDate),
        0
    )

VAR AnnualTarget =
    [Salesperson Target]

RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(AnnualTarget) || ISBLANK(MonthsToCompare),
        BLANK(),
        AnnualTarget * DIVIDE(MonthsToCompare, 12)
    )
